sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The TopJets class, implemented in Cython, is a specialized selection template within the AnalysisG framework, designed for comprehensive analysis of top-tagged jets and their underlying parton associations in Monte Carlo 16 (MC16) events. It inherits from the generic SelectionTemplate class, extending its functionalities to extract and organize detailed information about jet masses, parton contributions to jets, and the relationship between jets and top quarks. This class facilitates a high-performance extraction and structuring of top-jet data for further physics analysis.

sect1.title: The TopJets Class
sect1.para: TopJets is a cdef class, indicating its implementation as a Cython extension type. It inherits from SelectionTemplate, thereby gaining all the base functionalities for event selection, ROOT file interpretation, and weight management. Its primary role is to encapsulate a C++ topjets object, which likely contains the logic for identifying top-tagged jets, associating them with partons, and calculating relevant kinematic properties.

listitem.para: __cinit__(self): The Cython "constructor" equivalent, called during object allocation. It initializes a new C++ topjets object and assigns its pointer to self.ptr. It then upcasts self.ptr to a topjets* and assigns it to self.tt for specialized access.
__init__(self): (Not explicitly defined in the provided snippet) This would typically be the Python initializer.
__dealloc__(self): The Cython "destructor" equivalent, called upon object deallocation. It deallocates the C++ topjets object pointed to by self.tt, ensuring proper memory management.

cdef void transform_dict_keys(self): This method is responsible for converting the C++ data structures within the underlying topjets object into Python dictionaries and lists, making them accessible as properties of the TopJets instance.
self.top_mass: Populated from self.tt.top_mass (masses of top quarks).
self.jet_partons: Populated from self.tt.jet_partons (partons associated with jets).
self.jets_contribute: Populated from self.tt.jets_contribute (contributions of jets to various categories).
self.jet_top: Populated from self.tt.jet_top (top quarks associated with jets).
self.jet_mass: Populated from self.tt.jet_mass (masses of jets).
self.ntops_lost: Populated from self.tt.ntops_lost (number of lost top quarks).

sect2.title: Properties

sect1.title: C++ Interaction
sect1.para:
The TopJets class leverages Cython's capabilities for seamless C++ integration:
cdef class TopJets: Declares TopJets as a Cython extension type.
cdef topjets *tt: A C++ pointer to a topjets object, which is the specialized C++ implementation for top-jet analysis.
self.ptr = new topjets(): Initializes the base SelectionTemplate's C++ pointer.
self.tt = <topjets*>self.ptr: This line demonstrates C++ upcasting, allowing TopJets to fulfill the SelectionTemplate interface while internally managing its specific topjets data.
from AnalysisG.core.selection_template cimport SelectionTemplate: Imports the base SelectionTemplate class, from which TopJets inherits.
from AnalysisG.selections.mc16.topjets.topjets cimport *: Imports the C++ topjets class declaration from its .pxd file.
from AnalysisG.core.tools cimport *: Imports utility functions for converting between C++ and Python data structures, specifically as_dict_dict_dict, as_dict_dict, as_dict, and as_list.
